pt.title: Previsões de Compras de Fim de Ano Chegam: As Famílias Apertadas Vão Gastar, Endividar-se ou Conter-se?

segments.src: Holiday forecast season has begun.
segments.tr: A temporada de previsões de fim de ano começou.

segments.src: Retail trade groups, consulting firms and individual chains are releasing their outlooks for the months ahead, and many are announcing seasonal hiring plans at the same time.
segments.tr: Grupos de comércio varejista, firmas de consultoria e redes individuais estão divulgando suas perspectivas para os próximos meses, e muitos estão anunciando planos de contratação sazonal ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: The forecasts tend to sound confident.
segments.tr: As previsões tendem a soar confiantes.

segments.src: The households they depend on face a more mixed picture.
segments.tr: As famílias de que dependem enfrentam um cenário mais misto.

segments.src: This article looks at the pressures on shoppers, the categories and income groups most likely to shape the season, and what to watch as the numbers come in.
segments.tr: Este artigo analisa as pressões sobre os compradores, as categorias e faixas de renda com maior probabilidade de moldar a temporada, and o que observar à medida que os números chegam.

segments.src: It does not predict specific results.
segments.tr: Ele não prevê resultados específicos.

segments.src: Forecasts are estimates, and they are often revised.
segments.tr: As previsões são estimativas e muitas vezes são revisadas.

segments.src: ## Why this season is hard to read
segments.tr: ## Por que esta temporada é difícil de ler

segments.src: Several forces are pulling in different directions.
segments.tr: Várias forças estão puxando em direções diferentes.

segments.src: - **Credit card balances.** Household revolving debt has been a recurring theme in consumer finance reports. Higher balances can support spending in the short term, but they also leave less room for new borrowing later.
segments.tr: - **Saldos de cartão de crédito.** A dívida rotativa das famílias tem sido um tema recorrente nos relatórios de finanças do consumidor. Saldos mais altos podem apoiar os gastos no curto prazo, mas também deixam menos margem para novos empréstimos mais tarde.

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Interest rates on cards and other loans remain a meaningful burden for many families. That makes financing a purchase more expensive and may push some shoppers toward cash, debit or layaway-style plans.
segments.tr: - **Custos de empréstimo.** As taxas de juros de cartões e outros empréstimos continuam sendo um peso significativo para muitas famílias. Isso torna o financiamento de uma compra mais caro e pode empurrar alguns compradores para dinheiro, débito ou planos no estilo carnê.

segments.src: - **Price fatigue.** Even where inflation has cooled, many people still compare today's prices with those from a few years ago. That shapes how they judge a "good deal."
segments.tr: - **Fadiga de preços.** Mesmo onde a inflação arrefeceu, muitas pessoas ainda comparam os preços de hoje com os de alguns anos atrás. Isso molda como elas julgam uma "boa oferta".

segments.src: - **Election-year uncertainty.** Surveys often show that households feel less sure about the economy around major elections. Uncertainty does not always change behavior, but it can make people more cautious about big purchases.
segments.tr: - **Incerteza de ano eleitoral.** As pesquisas frequentemente mostram que as famílias se sentem menos seguras sobre a economia em torno de grandes eleições. A incerteza nem sempre muda o comportamento, mas pode tornar as pessoas mais cautelosas com compras grandes.

segments.src: ## What the forecasts usually say
segments.tr: ## O que as previsões geralmente dizem

segments.src: Industry outlooks generally offer a range, from modest growth to flat results, rather than a single number.
segments.tr: As perspectivas do setor geralmente oferecem uma faixa, desde crescimento modesto até resultados estagnados, em vez de um único número.

segments.src: Most also stress a few common themes:
segments.tr: A maioria também enfatiza alguns temas comuns:

segments.src: 1. **Spending may grow more slowly than in past strong years.** Forecasters often describe a "steady but careful" consumer.
segments.tr: 1. **Os gastos podem crescer mais devagar do que em anos fortes anteriores.** Os previsores frequentemente descrevem um consumidor "constante, mas cuidadoso".

segments.src: 2. **Promotions start earlier.** Retailers have spread sales across more weeks, which can smooth demand but also trains shoppers to wait for discounts.
segments.tr: 2. **As promoções começam mais cedo.** Os varejistas espalharam as vendas por mais semanas, o que pode suavizar a demanda, mas também treina os compradores a esperarem por descontos.

segments.src: 3. **Online and in-store shopping both matter.** Many shoppers research online and then choose how to buy based on price, delivery speed and convenience.
segments.tr: 3. **Compras online e em loja física importam.** Muitos compradores pesquisam online e depois escolhem como comprar com base em preço, velocidade de entrega e conveniência.

segments.src: 4. **Seasonal hiring is a signal, not a guarantee.** Hiring announcements show how confident a retailer is. Companies can scale back if sales fall short.
segments.tr: 4. **A contratação sazonal é um sinal, não uma garantia.** Os anúncios de contratação mostram quão confiante um varejista está. As empresas podem reduzir se as vendas ficarem abaixo do esperado.

segments.src: ## Which categories may drive the season
segments.tr: ## Quais categorias podem impulsionar a temporada

segments.src: Different parts of the market face different conditions.
segments.tr: Diferentes partes do mercado enfrentam condições diferentes.

segments.src: **Likely to hold up better**
segments.tr: **Com maior probabilidade de se manterem bem**

segments.src: - Essentials and gifts that feel practical, such as clothing, household goods and groceries for holiday meals.
segments.tr: - Essenciais e presentes que parecem práticos, como roupas, utilidades domésticas e mantimentos para refeições de festas.

segments.src: - Lower-priced gifts and stocking items, where the cost of a mistake is small.
segments.tr: - Presentes de menor preço e itens de meia de Natal, onde o custo de um erro é pequeno.

segments.src: - Experiences and travel, which many households continue to prioritize even while trimming other spending.
segments.tr: - Experiências e viagens, que muitas famílias continuam a priorizar mesmo cortando outros gastos.

segments.src: **Likely to face more caution**
segments.tr: **Com maior probabilidade de enfrentar mais cautela**

segments.src: - Big-ticket items such as furniture, major appliances and high-end electronics, which are more sensitive to financing costs.
segments.tr: - Itens de alto valor, como móveis, grandes eletrodomésticos e eletrônicos de ponta, que são mais sensíveis aos custos de financiamento.

segments.src: - Discretionary extras that can be postponed or skipped.
segments.tr: - Extras discricionários que podem ser adiados ou pulados.

segments.src: **Likely to see mixed results**
segments.tr: **Com probabilidade de ver resultados mistos**

segments.src: - Consumer electronics, where new product releases and discounts can lift demand, but where shoppers also compare prices closely.
segments.tr: - Eletrônicos de consumo, onde novos lançamentos de produtos e descontos podem elevar a demanda, mas onde os compradores também comparam preços de perto.

segments.src: - Toys and hobby items, which often depend on a few popular products.
segments.tr: - Brinquedos e itens de hobby, que frequentemente dependem de alguns produtos populares.

segments.src: ## Which income groups matter most
segments.tr: ## Quais faixas de renda importam mais

segments.src: Spending is not spread evenly across households.
segments.tr: Os gastos não estão distribuídos uniformemente entre as famílias.

segments.src: - **Higher-income households** account for a large share of total consumer spending. Their finances are often supported by savings, investment holdings or home equity, so they tend to be steadier. If they pull back, the effect on overall totals can be large.
segments.tr: - **Famílias de maior renda** respondem por uma grande fatia do total de gastos do consumidor. Suas finanças são frequentemente apoiadas por poupança, participações em investimentos ou patrimônio imobiliário, então tendem a ser mais estáveis. Se elas recuarem, o efeito nos totais gerais pode ser grande.

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** are often the swing group. They feel changes in prices, rates and job security most, and may split their budgets between "must-have" and "wait-and-see" purchases.
segments.tr: - **Famílias de renda média** são frequentemente o grupo oscilante. Elas sentem as mudanças nos preços, taxas e segurança no emprego de forma mais aguda, e podem dividir seus orçamentos entre compras "essenciais" e de "esperar para ver".

segments.src: - **Lower-income households** typically spend a large share of income on necessities. They have less room to absorb price increases, so many rely on credit, buy-now-pay-later plans, or discount retailers to stretch a budget.
segments.tr: - **Famílias de menor renda** tipicamente gastam uma grande fatia da renda com necessidades. Elas têm menos margem para absorver aumentos de preços, então muitas dependem de crédito, planos do tipo compre agora pague depois, ou varejistas de desconto para esticar o orçamento.

segments.src: Because of these differences, an overall forecast can hide a divided experience: some families spend freely while others cut back sharply.
segments.tr: Por causa dessas diferenças, uma previsão geral pode esconder uma experiência dividida: algumas famílias gastam livremente enquanto outras cortam drasticamente.

segments.src: ## Spend, borrow or hold back?
segments.tr: ## Gastar, endividar-se ou conter-se?

segments.src: Most shoppers will probably do some mix of all three.
segments.tr: A maioria dos compradores provavelmente fará alguma mistura de todos os três.

segments.src: - **Spend:** Households with stable income and savings are likely to keep up traditions, often with a clearer budget than before.
segments.tr: - **Gastar:** Famílias com renda estável e poupança provavelmente manterão as tradições, frequentemente com um orçamento mais claro do que antes.

segments.src: - **Borrow:** Some will use credit cards or installment plans to cover gifts. This can work when it is planned and paid off quickly, and it can be costly when balances carry into the new year.
segments.tr: - **Endividar-se:** Alguns usarão cartões de crédito ou planos de parcelamento para cobrir presentes. Isso pode funcionar quando é planejado e pago rapidamente, e pode ser custoso quando os saldos passam para o ano novo.

segments.src: - **Hold back:** Others will shorten gift lists, set spending limits, buy secondhand, or wait for the deepest discounts.
segments.tr: - **Conter-se:** Outros encurtarão as listas de presentes, definirão limites de gastos, comprarão usados ou esperarão pelos descontos mais profundos.

segments.src: ## Practical steps for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Passos práticos para compradores

segments.tr: - Defina um orçamento total antes de navegar, e acompanhe-o conforme avança.

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers and check return policies.
segments.tr: - Compare preços entre varejistas e verifique as políticas de devolução.

segments.src: - Be careful with financing offers. Read the interest terms and any fees, and consider whether you could pay the balance off in full.
segments.tr: - Tenha cuidado com ofertas de financiamento. Leia os termos de juros e quaisquer taxas, e considere se você conseguiria pagar o saldo integralmente.

segments.src: - Avoid carrying a large holiday balance into the new year if you can.
segments.tr: - Evite carregar um saldo grande de fim de ano para o ano novo se puder.

segments.src: - Watch for scams around the busy shopping period, especially unexpected links, fake delivery notices and deals that seem too good to be true.
segments.tr: - Fique atento a golpes durante o período movimentado de compras, especialmente links inesperados, avisos de entrega falsos e ofertas que parecem boas demais para ser verdade.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar em seguida

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Resumo

segments.src: The most likely outcome is a season of selective spending.
segments.tr: O resultado mais provável é uma temporada de gastos seletivos.

segments.src: Many households will still shop, but they are expected to be more deliberate about what they buy, when they buy it and how they pay.
segments.tr: Muitas famílias ainda farão compras, mas espera-se que sejam mais deliberadas sobre o que compram, quando compram e como pagam.

segments.tr: Para os varejistas, o desafio é atrair compradores cuidadosos sem depender apenas de descontos profundos.

segments.src: ## Why this season is hard to read

segments.src: Several forces are pulling in different directions.
segments.tr: Beberapa kekuatan saling menarik ke arah yang berbeda.

segments.src: - **Credit card balances.** Household revolving debt has been a recurring theme in consumer finance reports. Higher balances can support spending in the short term, but they also leave less room for new borrowing later.
segments.tr: - **Saldo kartu kredit.** Utang bergulir rumah tangga telah menjadi tema berulang dalam laporan keuangan konsumen. Saldo yang lebih tinggi dapat mendukung pengeluaran dalam jangka pendek, tetapi juga menyisakan lebih sedikit ruang untuk pinjaman baru di kemudian hari.

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Interest rates on cards and other loans remain a meaningful burden for many families. That makes financing a purchase more expensive and may push some shoppers toward cash, debit or layaway-style plans.
segments.tr: - **Biaya pinjaman.** Suku bunga pada kartu dan pinjaman lainnya tetap menjadi beban yang berarti bagi banyak keluarga. Hal tersebut membuat pembiayaan pembelian menjadi lebih mahal dan dapat mendorong beberapa pembeli beralih ke uang tunai, debit, atau rencana gaya cicilan.

segments.src: - **Price fatigue.** Even where inflation has cooled, many people still compare today's prices with those from a few years ago. That shapes how they judge a "good deal."
segments.tr: - **Kelesuan harga.** Bahkan di tempat di mana inflasi telah mendingin, banyak orang masih membandingkan harga hari ini dengan harga dari beberapa tahun yang lalu. Hal itu membentuk cara mereka menilai "penawaran bagus."

segments.src: - **Election-year uncertainty.** Surveys often show that households feel less sure about the economy around major elections. Uncertainty does not always change behavior, but it can make people more cautious about big purchases.
segments.tr: - **Ketidakpastian tahun pemilihan umum.** Survei sering kali menunjukkan bahwa rumah tangga merasa kurang yakin tentang perekonomian menjelang pemilihan umum besar. Ketidakpastian tidak selalu mengubah perilaku, tetapi dapat membuat orang lebih berhati-hati terhadap pembelian besar.

segments.src: ## What the forecasts usually say
segments.tr: ## Apa yang biasanya dikatakan oleh prakiraan

segments.src: Industry outlooks generally offer a range, from modest growth to flat results, rather than a single number.
segments.tr: Prospek industri umumnya menawarkan kisaran, dari pertumbuhan moderat hingga hasil yang datar, alih-alih satu angka tunggal.

segments.src: Most also stress a few common themes:
segments.tr: Sebagian besar juga menekankan beberapa tema umum:

segments.src: 1. **Spending may grow more slowly than in past strong years.** Forecasters often describe a "steady but careful" consumer.
segments.tr: 1. **Pengeluaran mungkin tumbuh lebih lambat dibandingkan tahun-tahun kuat sebelumnya.** Para peramal sering kali menggambarkan konsumen yang "stabil tetapi berhati-hati."

segments.src: 2. **Promotions start earlier.** Retailers have spread sales across more weeks, which can smooth demand but also trains shoppers to wait for discounts.
segments.tr: 2. **Promosi dimulai lebih awal.** Peritel telah menyebarkan penjualan ke lebih banyak minggu, yang dapat meratakan permintaan tetapi juga melatih pembeli untuk menunggu diskon.

segments.src: 3. **Online and in-store shopping both matter.** Many shoppers research online and then choose how to buy based on price, delivery speed and convenience.
segments.tr: 3. **Belanja online dan di toko fisik sama-sama penting.** Banyak pembeli melakukan riset secara online dan kemudian memilih cara membeli berdasarkan harga, kecepatan pengiriman, dan kenyamanan.

segments.src: 4. **Seasonal hiring is a signal, not a guarantee.** Hiring announcements show how confident a retailer is. Companies can scale back if sales fall short.
segments.tr: 4. **Perekrutan musiman adalah sebuah sinyal, bukan jaminan.** Pengumuman perekrutan menunjukkan seberapa percaya diri seorang peritel. Perusahaan dapat mengurangi skala jika penjualan tidak mencapai target.

segments.src: ## Which categories may drive the season
segments.tr: ## Kategori mana yang mungkin menggerakkan musim ini

segments.src: Different parts of the market face different conditions.
segments.tr: Bagian pasar yang berbeda menghadapi kondisi yang berbeda pula.

segments.src: **Likely to hold up better**
segments.tr: **Kemungkinan bertahan lebih baik**

segments.src: - Essentials and gifts that feel practical, such as clothing, household goods and groceries for holiday meals.
segments.tr: - Kebutuhan pokok dan hadiah yang terasa praktis, seperti pakaian, barang rumah tangga, dan bahan makanan untuk santapan liburan.

segments.src: - Lower-priced gifts and stocking items, where the cost of a mistake is small.
segments.tr: - Hadiah berharga lebih murah dan barang pengisi stocking, di mana biaya kesalahan kecil.

segments.src: - Experiences and travel, which many households continue to prioritize even while trimming other spending.
segments.tr: - Pengalaman dan perjalanan, yang terus diprioritaskan oleh banyak rumah tangga bahkan saat memangkas pengeluaran lainnya.

segments.src: **Likely to face more caution**
segments.tr: **Kemungkinan menghadapi lebih banyak kehati-hatian**

segments.src: - Big-ticket items such as furniture, major appliances and high-end electronics, which are more sensitive to financing costs.
segments.tr: - Barang-barang bernilai tinggi seperti furnitur, peralatan rumah tangga besar, dan elektronik kelas atas, yang lebih sensitif terhadap biaya pembiayaan.

segments.src: - Discretionary extras that can be postponed or skipped.
segments.tr: - Barang tambahan diskresioner yang dapat ditunda atau dilewati.

segments.src: **Likely to see mixed results**
segments.tr: **Kemungkinan melihat hasil yang beragam**

segments.src: - Consumer electronics, where new product releases and discounts can lift demand, but where shoppers also compare prices closely.
segments.tr: - Elektronik konsumen, di mana rilis produk baru dan diskon dapat meningkatkan permintaan, tetapi di mana pembeli juga membandingkan harga secara cermat.

segments.src: - Toys and hobby items, which often depend on a few popular products.
segments.tr: - Mainan dan barang hobi, yang sering kali bergantung pada beberapa produk populer.

segments.src: ## Which income groups matter most
segments.tr: ## Kelompok pendapatan mana yang paling penting

segments.src: Spending is not spread evenly across households.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran tidak tersebar merata di seluruh rumah tangga.

segments.src: - **Higher-income households** account for a large share of total consumer spending. Their finances are often supported by savings, investment holdings or home equity, so they tend to be steadier. If they pull back, the effect on overall totals can be large.
segments.tr: - **Rumah tangga berpendapatan tinggi** menyumbang sebagian besar dari total pengeluaran konsumen. Keuangan mereka sering kali didukung oleh tabungan, kepemilikan investasi, atau ekuitas rumah, sehingga mereka cenderung lebih stabil. Jika mereka menarik diri, efek pada total keseluruhan bisa sangat besar.

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** are often the swing group. They feel changes in prices, rates and job security most, and may split their budgets between "must-have" and "wait-and-see" purchases.
segments.tr: - **Rumah tangga berpendapatan menengah** sering kali menjadi kelompok penentu. Mereka paling merasakan perubahan harga, suku bunga, dan keamanan pekerjaan, serta dapat membagi anggaran mereka antara pembelian "yang harus dimiliki" dan "tunggu dan lihat."

segments.src: - **Lower-income households** typically spend a large share of income on necessities. They have less room to absorb price increases, so many rely on credit, buy-now-pay-later plans, or discount retailers to stretch a budget.
segments.tr: - **Rumah tangga berpendapatan rendah** biasanya menghabiskan sebagian besar pendapatannya untuk kebutuhan pokok. Mereka memiliki lebih sedikit ruang untuk menyerap kenaikan harga, sehingga banyak yang mengandalkan kredit, rencana beli sekarang bayar nanti, atau peritel diskon untuk memaksimalkan anggaran.

segments.src: Because of these differences, an overall forecast can hide a divided experience: some families spend freely while others cut back sharply.
segments.tr: Karena perbedaan-perbedaan ini, prakiraan keseluruhan dapat menyembunyikan pengalaman yang terbagi: beberapa keluarga berbelanja secara bebas sementara yang lain memangkas pengeluaran secara tajam.

segments.src: ## Spend, borrow or hold back?
segments.tr: ## Berbelanja, meminjam, atau menahan diri?

segments.src: Most shoppers will probably do some mix of all three.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar pembeli mungkin akan melakukan kombinasi dari ketiganya.

segments.src: - **Spend:** Households with stable income and savings are likely to keep up traditions, often with a clearer budget than before.
segments.tr: - **Berbelanja:** Rumah tangga dengan pendapatan dan tabungan yang stabil cenderung mempertahankan tradisi, sering kali dengan anggaran yang lebih jelas dari sebelumnya.

segments.src: - **Borrow:** Some will use credit cards or installment plans to cover gifts. This can work when it is planned and paid off quickly, and it can be costly when balances carry into the new year.
segments.tr: - **Meminjam:** Beberapa akan menggunakan kartu kredit atau rencana cicilan untuk menutupi hadiah. Ini dapat berhasil ketika direncanakan dan dilunasi dengan cepat, dan bisa menjadi mahal ketika saldo terbawa ke tahun baru.

segments.src: - **Hold back:** Others will shorten gift lists, set spending limits, buy secondhand, or wait for the deepest discounts.
segments.tr: - **Menahan diri:** Yang lain akan memperpendek daftar hadiah, menetapkan batas pengeluaran, membeli barang bekas, atau menunggu diskon terbesar.

segments.src: ## Practical steps for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Langkah praktis bagi pembeli

segments.src: - Set a total budget before browsing, and track it as you go.
segments.tr: - Tetapkan total anggaran sebelum menjelajah, dan pantau saat Anda berbelanja.

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers and check return policies.
segments.tr: - Bandingkan harga di berbagai peritel dan periksa kebijakan pengembalian.

segments.src: - Be careful with financing offers. Read the interest terms and any fees, and consider whether you could pay the balance off in full.
segments.tr: - Berhati-hatilah dengan penawaran pembiayaan. Baca ketentuan bunga dan biaya apa pun, serta pertimbangkan apakah Anda dapat melunasi saldo secara penuh.

segments.src: - Avoid carrying a large holiday balance into the new year if you can.
segments.tr: - Hindari membawa saldo liburan yang besar ke tahun baru jika memungkinkan.

segments.src: - Watch for scams around the busy shopping period, especially unexpected links, fake delivery notices and deals that seem too good to be true.
segments.tr: - Waspadai penipuan di sekitar periode belanja yang sibuk, terutama tautan tak terduga, pemberitahuan pengiriman palsu, dan penawaran yang tampak terlalu bagus untuk menjadi kenyataan.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang perlu diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: As the season goes on, several indicators will show whether the forecasts hold up: retail sales reports, consumer confidence surveys, delivery and shipping volumes, credit and delinquency data, and the results retailers report after the season ends.
segments.tr: Seiring berjalannya musim, beberapa indikator akan menunjukkan apakah prakiraan tersebut bertahan: laporan penjualan ritel, survei kepercayaan konsumen, volume pengiriman dan pengiriman barang, data kredit dan tunggakan, serta hasil yang dilaporkan peritel setelah musim berakhir.

segments.src: Early signals, such as the pace of sales in the weeks before the main shopping days, can be useful but are often revised.
segments.tr: Sinyal awal, seperti kecepatan penjualan dalam minggu-minggu sebelum hari belanja utama, dapat berguna tetapi sering kali direvisi.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The most likely outcome is a season of selective spending.
segments.tr: Hasil yang paling mungkin adalah musim pengeluaran selektif.

segments.src: Many households will still shop, but they are expected to be more deliberate about what they buy, when they buy it and how they pay.
segments.tr: Banyak rumah tangga akan tetap berbelanja, tetapi mereka diharapkan lebih sengaja tentang apa yang mereka beli, kapan mereka membelinya, dan bagaimana mereka membayar.

segments.src: For retailers, the challenge is to attract careful shoppers without relying only on deep discounts.
segments.tr: Bagi peritel, tantangannya adalah menarik pembeli yang berhati-hati tanpa hanya mengandalkan diskon besar-besaran.

segments.src: For families, the best approach is a realistic budget and a clear view of what they can afford once the holidays are over.
segments.tr: Bagi keluarga, pendekatan terbaik adalah anggaran yang realistis dan pandangan yang jelas tentang apa yang mampu mereka beli begitu liburan usai.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan.

segments.src: Forecasts are estimates and may change.*
segments.tr: Prakiraan adalah estimasi dan dapat berubah.*

ja.title: ホリデーシーズンの買い物予測が出そろう：家計が圧迫される中、消費者は支出するか、借金するか、それとも買い控えるか？

segments.src: Holiday forecast season has begun.
segments.tr: ホリデーシーズンの予測シーズンが始まった。

segments.src: Retail trade groups, consulting firms and individual chains are releasing their outlooks for the months ahead, and many are announcing seasonal hiring plans at the same time.
segments.tr: 小売業界団体、コンサルティング会社、個別チェーンが今後の見通しを発表しており、同時に多くの企業が季節雇用の計画を発表している。

segments.src: The forecasts tend to sound confident.
segments.tr: 予測は自信に満ちたものになりがちである。

segments.src: The households they depend on face a more mixed picture.
segments.tr: しかし、その予測が依存している家計が直面している状況は、より複雑である。

segments.src: This article looks at the pressures on shoppers, the categories and income groups most likely to shape the season, and what to watch as the numbers come in.
segments.tr: この記事では、買い物客にかかるプレッシャー、今シーズンを大きく左右しそうな品目や所得層、そして数字が出てきた際に注目すべき点について見ていく。

segments.src: It does not predict specific results.
segments.tr: 特定の成果を予測するものではない。

segments.src: Forecasts are estimates, and they are often revised.
segments.tr: 予測はあくまで推定であり、しばしば修正される。

segments.src: ## Why this season is hard to read
segments.tr: ## 今シーズンが読みづらい理由

segments.src: Several forces are pulling in different directions.
segments.tr: いくつかの力が互いに異なる方向に働いている。

segments.src: - **Credit card balances.** Household revolving debt has been a recurring theme in consumer finance reports. Higher balances can support spending in the short term, but they also leave less room for new borrowing later.
segments.tr: - **クレジットカードの残高。** 家計のリボルビング借入は、消費者金融レポートで繰り返し取り上げられるテーマとなっている。残高の増加は短期的には支出を下支えする可能性があるが、同時に将来の新たな借入余地を狭めることにもなる。

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Interest rates on cards and other loans remain a meaningful burden for many families. That makes financing a purchase more expensive and may push some shoppers toward cash, debit or layaway-style plans.
segments.tr: - **借入コスト。** クレジットカードやその他のローン金利は、多くの家族にとって依然として大きな負担である。そのため、買い物の資金調達コストが高くなり、一部の買い物客が現金、デビットカード、またはレイアウェイ（取り置き）方式のプランに流れる可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Price fatigue.** Even where inflation has cooled, many people still compare today's prices with those from a few years ago. That shapes how they judge a "good deal."
segments.tr: - **価格に対する疲労感。** インフレが落ち着いた地域でさえ、多くの人々は今なお現在の価格と数年前の価格を比較している。それが「お得感」をどのように判断するかに影響を与えている。

segments.src: - **Election-year uncertainty.** Surveys often show that households feel less sure about the economy around major elections. Uncertainty does not always change behavior, but it can make people more cautious about big purchases.
segments.tr: - **選挙イヤーの不確実性。** 調査によると、主要な選挙の時期には、家計は経済に対してより不安を感じる傾向がある。不確実性が常に行動を変えるわけではないが、高額な買い物に対して人々をより慎重にさせることはある。

segments.src: ## What the forecasts usually say
segments.tr: ## 予測が通常示していること

segments.src: Industry outlooks generally offer a range, from modest growth to flat results, rather than a single number.
segments.tr: 業界の見通しは、単一の数字ではなく、緩やかな成長から横ばいの結果まで幅広い範囲で示されることが一般的である。

segments.src: Most also stress a few common themes:
segments.tr: また、ほとんどの見通しで共通するいくつかのテーマが強調されている。

segments.src: 1. **Spending may grow more slowly than in past strong years.** Forecasters often describe a "steady but careful" consumer.
segments.tr: 1. **支出の伸びは、過去の好調な年ほど大きくない可能性がある。** 予測者はしばしば「堅実だが慎重な」消費者像を描く。

segments.src: 2. **Promotions start earlier.** Retailers have spread sales across more weeks, which can smooth demand but also trains shoppers to wait for discounts.
segments.tr: 2. **セールの開始が早まっている。** 小売業者はセール期間をより多くの週に分散させており、これにより需要を平準化できる一方で、買い物客に割引を待つ癖をつけることにもなり得る。

segments.src: 3. **Online and in-store shopping both matter.** Many shoppers research online and then choose how to buy based on price, delivery speed and convenience.
segments.tr: 3. **オンラインと店舗での買い物の双方が重要である。** 多くの買い物客はオンラインでリサーチを行い、価格、配送速度、利便性に基づいて購入方法を選択する。

segments.src: 4. **Seasonal hiring is a signal, not a guarantee.** Hiring announcements show how confident a retailer is. Companies can scale back if sales fall short.
segments.tr: 4. **季節雇用はシグナルであって保証ではない。** 採用の発表は、小売業者がどれほど自信を持っているかを示すものである。売上が振るわなければ、企業は規模を縮小することができる。

segments.src: ## Which categories may drive the season
segments.tr: ## シーズンを牽引する可能性のあるカテゴリー

segments.src: Different parts of the market face different conditions.
segments.tr: 市場の各セグメントはそれぞれ異なる状況に直面している。

segments.src: **Likely to hold up better**
segments.tr: **底堅さを維持しそうなもの**

segments.src: - Essentials and gifts that feel practical, such as clothing, household goods and groceries for holiday meals.
segments.tr: - 衣料品、家庭用品、ホリデーの食事用の食料品など、実用的と感じられる必需品や贈り物。

segments.src: - Lower-priced gifts and stocking items, where the cost of a mistake is small.
segments.tr: - 価格が低めの贈り物や靴下に入るような小物類で、失敗した際のコストが小さいもの。

segments.src: - Experiences and travel, which many households continue to prioritize even while trimming other spending.
segments.tr: - 体験や旅行。他の支出を削る中でも、多くの家計が引き続き優先し続けている。

segments.src: **Likely to face more caution**
segments.tr: **より慎重な姿勢に直面しそうなもの**

segments.src: - Big-ticket items such as furniture, major appliances and high-end electronics, which are more sensitive to financing costs.
segments.tr: - 家具、大型家電、ハイエンドの電子機器などの高額商品は、資金調達コストの影響を受けやすい。

segments.src: - Discretionary extras that can be postponed or skipped.
segments.tr: - 延期したり見送ったりすることが可能な裁量的な余剰支出。

segments.src: **Likely to see mixed results**
segments.tr: **結果が分かれそうなもの**

segments.src: - Consumer electronics, where new product releases and discounts can lift demand, but where shoppers also compare prices closely.
segments.tr: - 家電製品。新商品の発売や割引によって需要が高まる可能性がある一方で、買い物客が価格を厳しく比較する分野でもある。

segments.src: - Toys and hobby items, which often depend on a few popular products.
segments.tr: - おもちゃやホビー用品。これらは多くの場合、少数の人気商品に左右される。

segments.src: ## Which income groups matter most
segments.tr: **最も重要な所得層**

segments.src: Spending is not spread evenly across households.
segments.tr: 支出は家計の間で均等に分散しているわけではない。

segments.src: - **Higher-income households** account for a large share of total consumer spending. Their finances are often supported by savings, investment holdings or home equity, so they tend to be steadier. If they pull back, the effect on overall totals can be large.
segments.tr: - **高所得層**は総消費者支出の大きな割合を占めている。彼らの家計は多くの場合、貯蓄、投資保有、または住宅の持ち分によって支えられているため、より安定している傾向がある。彼らが支出を控えた場合、全体の合計に対する影響は大きくなり得る。

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** are often the swing group. They feel changes in prices, rates and job security most, and may split their budgets between "must-have" and "wait-and-see" purchases.
segments.tr: - **中所得層**はしばしば変動の大きい層となる。価格、金利、雇用の安定性の変化を最も強く感じており、予算を「必須の買い物」と「様子見の買い物」に振り分ける可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Lower-income households** typically spend a large share of income on necessities. They have less room to absorb price increases, so many rely on credit, buy-now-pay-later plans, or discount retailers to stretch a budget.
segments.tr: - **低所得層**は通常、所得の大部分を必需品に費やしている。物価上昇を吸収する余裕が少ないため、多くの人が予算をやりくりするためにクレジット、後払い（BNPL）プラン、ディスカウントストアに頼っている。

segments.src: Because of these differences, an overall forecast can hide a divided experience: some families spend freely while others cut back sharply.
segments.tr: こうした違いがあるため、全体の予測は二分された実態を隠してしまうことがある。ある家族が気前よく使う一方で、別の家族は大幅に支出を切り詰めているのである。

segments.src: ## Spend, borrow or hold back?
segments.tr: ## 支出するのか、借金するのか、それとも控えるのか？

segments.src: Most shoppers will probably do some mix of all three.
segments.tr: ほとんどの買い物客はおそらく、これら3つを何らかの形で組み合わせて行うだろう。

segments.src: - **Spend:** Households with stable income and savings are likely to keep up traditions, often with a clearer budget than before.
segments.tr: - **支出する：** 安定した収入と貯蓄がある家計は、従来通りの習慣を維持する可能性が高く、多くの場合、以前よりも明確な予算を持って臨む。

segments.src: - **Borrow:** Some will use credit cards or installment plans to cover gifts. This can work when it is planned and paid off quickly, and it can be costly when balances carry into the new year.
segments.tr: - **借金する：** 贈り物の支払いにクレジットカードや分割払いを利用する人もいる。これは計画的に行われ、すぐに完済される場合には機能するが、残高が新年まで持ち越されると負担が大きくなる可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Hold back:** Others will shorten gift lists, set spending limits, buy secondhand, or wait for the deepest discounts.
segments.tr: - **控える：** 贈り物のリストを短くしたり、支出上限を設定したり、中古品を買ったり、最大の割引を待ったりする人もいる。

segments.src: ## Practical steps for shoppers
segments.tr: ## 買い物客のための実践的なステップ

segments.src: - Set a total budget before browsing, and track it as you go.
segments.tr: - 閲覧を始める前に全体の予算を設定し、進捗に合わせて追跡する。

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers and check return policies.
segments.tr: - 小売業者間で価格を比較し、返品ポリシーを確認する。

segments.src: - Be careful with financing offers. Read the interest terms and any fees, and consider whether you could pay the balance off in full.
segments.tr: - 資金調達のオファーには注意する。金利条件や各種手数料を読み込み、残高を一括返済できるかどうかを検討する。

segments.src: - Avoid carrying a large holiday balance into the new year if you can.
segments.tr: - 可能であれば、多額のホリデー残高を新年まで持ち越さないようにする。

segments.src: - Watch for scams around the busy shopping period, especially unexpected links, fake delivery notices and deals that seem too good to be true.
segments.tr: - 忙しい買い物期間中の詐欺に注意する。特に、予期せぬリンク、偽の配達通知、あまりにも話がうますぎる取引に気をつける。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 次に注目すべき点

segments.src: As the season goes on, several indicators will show whether the forecasts hold up: retail sales reports, consumer confidence surveys, delivery and shipping volumes, credit and delinquency data, and the results retailers report after the season ends.
segments.tr: シーズンが進むにつれて、小売売上高レポート、消費者信頼感調査、配送および出荷量、クレジットおよび延滞データ、そしてシーズン終了後に小売業者が発表する業績など、いくつかの指標が予測が正しいかどうかを示してくれる。

segments.src: Early signals, such as the pace of sales in the weeks before the main shopping days, can be useful but are often revised.
segments.tr: 本格的な買い物日を迎える数週間の売上のペースなどの初期のシグナルは有用であるが、しばしば修正される。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The most likely outcome is a season of selective spending.
segments.tr: 最も可能性の高い結果は、選択的な支出が行われるシーズンである。

segments.src: Many households will still shop, but they are expected to be more deliberate about what they buy, when they buy it and how they pay.
segments.tr: 多くの家計は依然として買い物をするものの、何を買うか、いつ買うか、どのように支払うかについて、より熟考することが期待されている。

segments.src: For retailers, the challenge is to attract careful shoppers without relying only on deep discounts.
segments.tr: 小売業者にとっての課題は、大幅な値引きだけに頼ることなく、慎重な買い物客を引きつけることである。

segments.src: For families, the best approach is a realistic budget and a clear view of what they can afford once the holidays are over.
segments.tr: 家族にとって最善のアプローチは、現実的な予算と、ホリデーが終わった後に何が購入可能なのかについての明確な見通しを持つことである。

de.title: Weihnachtseinkaufsprognosen treffen ein: Werden eingeengte Haushalte Geld ausgeben, sich verschulden oder sich zurückhalten?

segments.src: Holiday forecast season has begun.
segments.tr: Die Prognosesaison für die Feiertage hat begonnen.

segments.src: Retail trade groups, consulting firms and individual chains are releasing their outlooks for the months ahead, and many are announcing seasonal hiring plans at the same time.
segments.tr: Handelsverbände, Beratungsunternehmen und einzelne Ketten veröffentlichen ihre Aussichten für die kommenden Monate, und viele kündigen gleichzeitig saisonale Pläne für Neueinstellungen an.

segments.src: The forecasts tend to sound confident.
segments.tr: Die Prognosen klingen meist zuversichtlich.

segments.src: The households they depend on face a more mixed picture.
segments.tr: Die Haushalte, von denen sie abhängen, sehen sich jedoch einem gemischteren Bild gegenüber.

segments.src: This article looks at the pressures on shoppers, the categories and income groups most likely to shape the season, and what to watch as the numbers come in.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel beleuchtet den Druck auf die Käufer, die Kategorien und Einkommensgruppen, die die Saison am wahrscheinlichsten prägen werden, sowie die Dinge, auf die man bei eintreffenden Zahlen achten sollte.

segments.src: It does not predict specific results.
segments.tr: Er sagt keine spezifischen Ergebnisse voraus.

segments.src: Forecasts are estimates, and they are often revised.
segments.tr: Prognosen sind Schätzungen und werden oft revidiert.

segments.src: ## Why this season is hard to read
segments.tr: ## Warum diese Saison schwer einzuschätzen ist

segments.src: Several forces are pulling in different directions.
segments.tr: Mehrere Kräfte wirken in unterschiedliche Richtungen.

segments.src: - **Credit card balances.** Household revolving debt has been a recurring theme in consumer finance reports. Higher balances can support spending in the short term, but they also leave less room for new borrowing later.
segments.tr: - **Kreditkartensalden.** Revolvierende Schulden von Haushalten waren ein wiederkehrendes Thema in Berichten zur Verbraucherfinanzierung. Höhere Salden können die Ausgaben kurzfristig stützen, lassen aber auch weniger Spielraum für spätere Neuaufnahmen von Krediten.

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Interest rates on cards and other loans remain a meaningful burden for many families. That makes financing a purchase more expensive and may push some shoppers toward cash, debit or layaway-style plans.
segments.tr: - **Kreditkosten.** Die Zinssätze für Karten und andere Kredite bleiben für viele Familien eine spürbare Belastung. Das verteuert die Finanzierung von Käufen und drängt einige Käufer möglicherweise zu Bargeld, Debitkarten oder Ratenkaufplänen.

segments.src: - **Price fatigue.** Even where inflation has cooled, many people still compare today's prices with those from a few years ago. That shapes how they judge a "good deal."
segments.tr: - **Preismüdigkeit.** Selbst dort, wo die Inflation nachgelassen hat, vergleichen viele Menschen die heutigen Preise immer noch mit denen vor einigen Jahren. Das prägt die Art und Weise, wie sie ein „gutes Geschäft“ beurteilen.

segments.src: - **Election-year uncertainty.** Surveys often show that households feel less sure about the economy around major elections. Uncertainty does not always change behavior, but it can make people more cautious about big purchases.
segments.tr: - **Unsicherheit im Wahljahr.** Umfragen zeigen oft, dass Haushalte sich bei der Wirtschaftslage rund um wichtige Wahlen unsicherer fühlen. Unsicherheit ändert nicht immer das Verhalten, kann die Menschen aber vorsichtiger bei größeren Anschaffungen machen.

segments.src: ## What the forecasts usually say
segments.tr: ## Was die Prognosen üblicherweise besagen

segments.src: Industry outlooks generally offer a range, from modest growth to flat results, rather than a single number.
segments.tr: Branchenaussichten bieten im Allgemeinen eher eine Spanne von moderatem Wachstum bis hin zu stagnierenden Ergebnissen als eine einzelne Zahl.

segments.src: Most also stress a few common themes:
segments.tr: Die meisten betonen auch einige gemeinsame Themen:

segments.src: 1. **Spending may grow more slowly than in past strong years.** Forecasters often describe a "steady but careful" consumer.
segments.tr: 1. **Die Ausgaben könnten langsamer wachsen als in vergangenen starken Jahren.** Prognostiker beschreiben häufig einen „stetigen, aber vorsichtigen“ Verbraucher.

segments.src: 2. **Promotions start earlier.** Retailers have spread sales across more weeks, which can smooth demand but also trains shoppers to wait for discounts.
segments.tr: 2. **Werbeaktionen starten früher.** Händler haben Verkaufsaktionen auf mehr Wochen verteilt, was die Nachfrage glätten kann, aber die Käufer auch darauf trainiert, auf Rabatte zu warten.

segments.src: 3. **Online and in-store shopping both matter.** Many shoppers research online and then choose how to buy based on price, delivery speed and convenience.
segments.tr: 3. **Online- und stationärer Einkauf sind gleichermaßen wichtig.** Viele Käufer recherchieren online und entscheiden dann je nach Preis, Liefergeschwindigkeit und Bequemlichkeit, wie sie kaufen möchten.

segments.src: 4. **Seasonal hiring is a signal, not a guarantee.** Hiring announcements show how confident a retailer is. Companies can scale back if sales fall short.
segments.tr: 4. **Saisonale Neueinstellungen sind ein Signal, keine Garantie.** Einstellungen zeigen, wie zuversichtlich ein Händler ist. Unternehmen können das Personal reduzieren, wenn die Umsätze hinter den Erwartungen zurückbleiben.

segments.src: ## Which categories may drive the season
segments.tr: ## Welche Kategorien die Saison antreiben könnten

segments.src: Different parts of the market face different conditions.
segments.tr: Verschiedene Teile des Marktes stehen vor unterschiedlichen Bedingungen.

segments.src: **Likely to hold up better**
segments.tr: **Wahrscheinlich stabiler**

segments.src: - Essentials and gifts that feel practical, such as clothing, household goods and groceries for holiday meals.
segments.tr: - Grundbedürfnisse und Geschenke, die sich praktisch anfühlen, wie Kleidung, Haushaltswaren und Lebensmittel für Feiertagsmahlzeiten.

segments.src: - Lower-priced gifts and stocking items, where the cost of a mistake is small.
segments.tr: - Günstigere Geschenke und Kleinigkeiten für den Strumpf, bei denen die Kosten eines Fehlers gering sind.

segments.src: - Experiences and travel, which many households continue to prioritize even while trimming other spending.
segments.tr: - Erlebnisse und Reisen, die viele Haushalte weiterhin priorisieren, selbst während sie andere Ausgaben kürzen.

segments.src: **Likely to face more caution**
segments.tr: **Wahrscheinlich mit mehr Zurückhaltung**

segments.src: - Big-ticket items such as furniture, major appliances and high-end electronics, which are more sensitive to financing costs.
segments.tr: - Teure Anschaffungen wie Möbel, Großgeräte und High-End-Elektronik, die empfindlicher auf die Finanzierungskosten reagieren.

segments.src: - Discretionary extras that can be postponed or skipped.
segments.tr: - Unverbindliche Extras, die verschoben oder ausgelassen werden können.

segments.src: **Likely to see mixed results**
segments.tr: **Wahrscheinlich mit gemischten Ergebnissen**

segments.src: - Consumer electronics, where new product releases and discounts can lift demand, but where shoppers also compare prices closely.
segments.tr: - Unterhaltungselektronik, bei der neue Produktveröffentlichungen und Rabatte die Nachfrage ankurbeln können, bei der Käufer die Preise aber auch genau vergleichen.

segments.src: - Toys and hobby items, which often depend on a few popular products.
segments.tr: - Spielzeug und Hobbyartikel, die oft von einigen wenigen beliebten Produkten abhängen.

segments.src: ## Which income groups matter most
segments.tr: ## Welche Einkommensgruppen am wichtigsten sind

segments.src: Spending is not spread evenly across households.
segments.tr: Die Ausgaben verteilen sich nicht gleichmäßig auf die Haushalte.

segments.src: - **Higher-income households** account for a large share of total consumer spending. Their finances are often supported by savings, investment holdings or home equity, so they tend to be steadier. If they pull back, the effect on overall totals can be large.
segments.tr: - **Haushalte mit höherem Einkommen** machen einen großen Teil der Gesamtausgaben der Verbraucher aus. Ihre Finanzen werden oft durch Ersparnisse, Investitionsbestände oder Eigenkapital gestützt, sodass sie tendenziell stabiler sind. Wenn sie sich zurückziehen, kann der Effekt auf die Gesamtsummen groß sein.

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** are often the swing group. They feel changes in prices, rates and job security most, and may split their budgets between "must-have" and "wait-and-see" purchases.
segments.tr: - **Haushalte mit mittlerem Einkommen** sind oft die Weichensteller. Sie spüren Änderungen bei Preisen, Zinsen und Arbeitsplatzsicherheit am stärksten und teilen ihre Budgets möglicherweise zwischen „Must-Have“- und „Abwarten“-Käufen auf.

segments.src: - **Lower-income households** typically spend a large share of income on necessities. They have less room to absorb price increases, so many rely on credit, buy-now-pay-later plans, or discount retailers to stretch a budget.
segments.tr: - **Haushalte mit geringerem Einkommen** geben typischerweise einen großen Teil ihres Einkommens für das Notwendigste aus. Sie haben weniger Spielraum, um Preiserhöhungen aufzufangen, weshalb sich viele auf Kredite, „Jetzt kaufen, später bezahlen“-Plane oder Discounter verlassen, um ein Budget zu strecken.

segments.src: Because of these differences, an overall forecast can hide a divided experience: some families spend freely while others cut back sharply.
segments.tr: Aufgrund dieser Unterschiede kann eine Gesamtprognose eine geteilte Erfahrung verbergen: Einige Familien geben freizügig Geld aus, während andere drastisch kürzen.

segments.src: ## Spend, borrow or hold back?
segments.tr: ## Ausgeben, leihen oder zurückhalten?

segments.src: Most shoppers will probably do some mix of all three.
segments.tr: Die meisten Käufer werden wahrscheinlich eine Mischung aus allen drei tun.

segments.src: - **Spend:** Households with stable income and savings are likely to keep up traditions, often with a clearer budget than before.
segments.tr: - **Ausgeben:** Haushalte mit stabilem Einkommen und Ersparnissen werden wahrscheinlich Traditionen fortführen, oft mit einem klareren Budget als zuvor.

segments.src: - **Borrow:** Some will use credit cards or installment plans to cover gifts. This can work when it is planned and paid off quickly, and it can be costly when balances carry into the new year.
segments.tr: - **Leihen:** Einige werden Kreditkarten oder Ratenzahlungspläne nutzen, um Geschenke zu finanzieren. Dies kann funktionieren, wenn es geplant und schnell abbezahlt wird, und es kann kostspielig sein, wenn Salden bis ins neue Jahr hineinreicht.

segments.src: - **Hold back:** Others will shorten gift lists, set spending limits, buy secondhand, or wait for the deepest discounts.
segments.tr: - **Zurückhalten:** Andere werden die Geschenklisten kürzen, Obergrenzen für Ausgaben festlegen, gebraucht kaufen oder auf die größten Rabatte warten.

segments.src: ## Practical steps for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Praktische Schritte für Käufer

segments.src: - Set a total budget before browsing, and track it as you go.
segments.tr: - Legen Sie vor dem Stöbern ein Gesamtbudget fest und verfolgen Sie es währenddessen.

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers and check return policies.
segments.tr: - Vergleichen Sie die Preise bei verschiedenen Händlern und überprüfen Sie die Rückgabebedingungen.

segments.src: - Be careful with financing offers. Read the interest terms and any fees, and consider whether you could pay the balance off in full.
segments.tr: - Seien Sie bei Finanzierungsangeboten vorsichtig. Lesen Sie die Zinsbedingungen und eventuelle Gebühren und überlegen Sie, ob Sie den Saldo vollständig begleichen könnten.

segments.src: - Avoid carrying a large holiday balance into the new year if you can.
segments.tr: - Vermeiden Sie es nach Möglichkeit, einen großen Feiertagssaldo ins neue Jahr mitzunehmen.

segments.src: - Watch for scams around the busy shopping period, especially unexpected links, fake delivery notices and deals that seem too good to be true.
segments.tr: - Achten Sie während der geschäftigen Einkaufszeit auf Betrug, insbesondere auf unerwartete Links, gefälschte Benachrichtigungen über Lieferungen und Angebote, die zu gut erscheinen, um wahr zu sein.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Worauf man als Nächstes achten sollte

segments.src: As the season goes on, several indicators will show whether the forecasts hold up: retail sales reports, consumer confidence surveys, delivery and shipping volumes, credit and delinquency data, and the results retailers report after the season ends.
segments.tr: Im Laufe der Saison werden mehrere Indikatoren zeigen, ob die Prognosen standhalten: Einzelhandelsumsatzberichte, Verbrauchervertrauensumfragen, Liefer- und Versandvolumina, Kredit- und Ausfalldaten sowie die Ergebnisse, die Händler nach Ende der Saison melden.

segments.src: Early signals, such as the pace of sales in the weeks before the main shopping days, can be useful but are often revised.
segments.tr: Frühe Signale wie das Tempo der Verkäufe in den Wochen vor den Hauptkinkaufstagen können nützlich sein, werden aber oft revidiert.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: The most likely outcome is a season of selective spending.
segments.tr: Das wahrscheinlichste Ergebnis ist eine Saison selektiver Ausgaben.

segments.src: Many households will still shop, but they are expected to be more deliberate about what they buy, when they buy it and how they pay.
segments.tr: Viele Haushalte werden weiterhin einkaufen, aber es wird erwartet, dass sie bewusster darüber entscheiden, was sie kaufen, wann sie es kaufen und wie sie bezahlen.

segments.src: For retailers, the challenge is to attract careful shoppers without relying only on deep discounts.
segments.tr: Für Händler besteht die Herausforderung darin, vorsichtige Käufer anzuziehen, ohne sich nur auf tiefe Rabatte zu verlassen.

segments.src: For families, the best approach is a realistic budget and a clear view of what they can afford once the holidays are over.
segments.tr: Für Familien ist der beste Ansatz ein realistisches Budget und ein klarer Blick darauf, was sie sich leisten können, sobald die Feiertage vorbei sind.

segments.src: ## Why this season is hard to read
segments.tr: ## Tại sao mùa này khó đoán

segments.src: Several forces are pulling in different directions.
segments.tr: Một số lực lượng đang kéo theo các hướng khác nhau.

segments.src: - **Credit card balances.** Household revolving debt has been a recurring theme in consumer finance reports. Higher balances can support spending in the short term, but they also leave less room for new borrowing later.
segments.tr: - **Số dư thẻ tín dụng.** Nợ quay vòng của hộ gia đình là một chủ đề lặp đi lặp lại trong các báo cáo tài chính tiêu dùng. Số dư cao hơn có thể hỗ trợ chi tiêu trong ngắn hạn, nhưng chúng cũng để lại ít dư địa hơn cho việc vay mượn mới sau này.

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Interest rates on cards and other loans remain a meaningful burden for many families. That makes financing a purchase more expensive and may push some shoppers toward cash, debit or layaway-style plans.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí vay mượn.** Lãi suất thẻ và các khoản vay khác vẫn là gánh nặng đáng kể đối với nhiều gia đình. Điều đó làm cho việc tài trợ cho một giao dịch mua sắm trở nên đắt đỏ hơn và có thể đẩy một số người mua sắm hướng tới tiền mặt, thẻ ghi nợ hoặc các kế hoạch trả góp kiểu giữ hàng (layaway).

segments.src: - **Price fatigue.** Even where inflation has cooled, many people still compare today's prices with those from a few years ago. That shapes how they judge a "good deal."
segments.tr: - **Sự mệt mỏi vì giá cả.** Ngay cả khi lạm phát đã hạ nhiệt, nhiều người vẫn so sánh giá cả ngày nay với giá từ vài năm trước. Điều đó định hình cách họ đánh giá một "món hời".

segments.src: - **Election-year uncertainty.** Surveys often show that households feel less sure about the economy around major elections. Uncertainty does not always change behavior, but it can make people more cautious about big purchases.
segments.tr: - **Sự bất định của năm bầu cử.** Các cuộc khảo sát thường cho thấy các hộ gia đình cảm thấy ít chắc chắn hơn về nền kinh tế xung quanh các cuộc bầu cử lớn. Sự bất định không phải lúc nào cũng làm thay đổi hành vi, nhưng nó có thể khiến mọi người thận trọng hơn đối với các giao dịch mua sắm lớn.

segments.src: ## What the forecasts usually say
segments.tr: ## Các dự báo thường nói gì

segments.src: Industry outlooks generally offer a range, from modest growth to flat results, rather than a single number.
segments.tr: Triển vọng ngành thường đưa ra một khoảng, từ mức tăng trưởng khiêm tốn đến kết quả đi ngang, thay vì một con số đơn lẻ.

segments.src: Most also stress a few common themes:
segments.tr: Hầu hết cũng nhấn mạnh một số chủ đề chung:

segments.src: 1. **Spending may grow more slowly than in past strong years.** Forecasters often describe a "steady but careful" consumer.
segments.tr: 1. **Chi tiêu có thể tăng trưởng chậm hơn so với các năm mạnh mẽ trước đây.** Các nhà dự báo thường mô tả người tiêu dùng "ổn định nhưng cẩn trọng".

segments.src: 2. **Promotions start earlier.** Retailers have spread sales across more weeks, which can smooth demand but also trains shoppers to wait for discounts.
segments.tr: 2. **Các chương trình khuyến mãi bắt đầu sớm hơn.** Các nhà bán lẻ đã phân bổ đợt giảm giá qua nhiều tuần hơn, điều này có thể làm phẳng nhu cầu nhưng cũng huấn luyện người mua sắm chờ đợi giảm giá.

segments.src: 3. **Online and in-store shopping both matter.** Many shoppers research online and then choose how to buy based on price, delivery speed and convenience.
segments.tr: 3. **Mua sắm trực tuyến và tại cửa hàng đều quan trọng.** Nhiều người mua sắm nghiên cứu trực tuyến sau đó chọn cách mua dựa trên giá cả, tốc độ giao hàng và sự tiện lợi.

segments.src: 4. **Seasonal hiring is a signal, not a guarantee.** Hiring announcements show how confident a retailer is. Companies can scale back if sales fall short.
segments.tr: 4. **Việc tuyển dụng theo mùa là một tín hiệu, không phải là sự đảm bảo.** Các thông báo tuyển dụng cho thấy nhà bán lẻ tự tin đến mức nào. Các công ty có thể thu hẹp quy mô nếu doanh số không đạt.

segments.src: Spending is not spread evenly across households.
segments.tr: Chi tiêu không phân bổ đều giữa các hộ gia đình.

segments.src: - **Higher-income households** account for a large share of total consumer spending. Their finances are often supported by savings, investment holdings or home equity, so they tend to be steadier. If they pull back, the effect on overall totals can be large.
segments.tr: - **Các hộ gia đình có thu nhập cao** chiếm phần lớn tổng chi tiêu tiêu dùng. Tài chính của họ thường được hỗ trợ bởi tiền tiết kiệm, nắm giữ đầu tư hoặc vốn chủ sở hữu nhà, vì vậy họ có xu hướng ổn định hơn. Nếu họ rút lui, ảnh hưởng đến tổng số chung có thể rất lớn.

segments.src: - **Middle-income households** are often the swing group. They feel changes in prices, rates and job security most, and may split their budgets between "must-have" and "wait-and-see" purchases.
segments.tr: - **Các hộ gia đình có thu nhập trung bình** thường là nhóm dao động. Họ cảm nhận rõ nhất những thay đổi về giá cả, lãi suất và an ninh việc làm, và có thể chia ngân sách của họ giữa các khoản mua sắm "phải có" và "chờ xem".

segments.src: - **Lower-income households** typically spend a large share of income on necessities. They have less room to absorb price increases, so many rely on credit, buy-now-pay-later plans, or discount retailers to stretch a budget.
segments.tr: - **Các hộ gia đình có thu nhập thấp** thường dành phần lớn thu nhập cho các nhu cầu thiết yếu. Họ có ít dư địa để hấp thụ việc tăng giá, vì vậy nhiều người dựa vào tín dụng, các kế hoạch mua trước trả sau, hoặc các nhà bán lẻ giảm giá để kéo dài ngân sách.

segments.src: Because of these differences, an overall forecast can hide a divided experience: some families spend freely while others cut back sharply.
segments.tr: Do những khác biệt này, một dự báo tổng thể có thể che giấu một trải nghiệm chia rẽ: một số gia đình chi tiêu thoải mái trong khi những gia đình khác cắt giảm mạnh mẽ.

segments.src: ## Spend, borrow or hold back?
segments.tr: ## Chi tiêu, vay mượn hay tiết chế?

segments.src: Most shoppers will probably do some mix of all three.
segments.tr: Hầu hết người mua sắm có lẽ sẽ thực hiện sự kết hợp của cả ba.

segments.src: - **Spend:** Households with stable income and savings are likely to keep up traditions, often with a clearer budget than before.
segments.tr: - **Chi tiêu:** Các hộ gia đình có thu nhập và tiết kiệm ổn định có nhiều khả năng duy trì các truyền thống, thường với ngân sách rõ ràng hơn trước.

segments.src: - **Borrow:** Some will use credit cards or installment plans to cover gifts. This can work when it is planned and paid off quickly, and it can be costly when balances carry into the new year.
segments.tr: - **Vay mượn:** Một số người sẽ sử dụng thẻ tín dụng hoặc các kế hoạch trả góp để mua quà tặng. Điều này có thể hiệu quả khi nó được lên kế hoạch và trả hết nhanh chóng, và có thể tốn kém khi số dư kéo dài sang năm mới.

segments.src: - **Hold back:** Others will shorten gift lists, set spending limits, buy secondhand, or wait for the deepest discounts.
segments.tr: - **Tiết chế:** Những người khác sẽ rút ngắn danh sách quà tặng, đặt ra giới hạn chi tiêu, mua đồ cũ hoặc chờ đợi mức giảm giá sâu nhất.

segments.src: ## Practical steps for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Các bước thiết thực cho người mua sắm

segments.src: - Set a total budget before browsing, and track it as you go.
segments.tr: - Đặt tổng ngân sách trước khi duyệt web và theo dõi nó khi bạn mua.

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers and check return policies.
segments.tr: - So sánh giá cả giữa các nhà bán lẻ và kiểm tra chính sách đổi trả.

segments.src: - Be careful with financing offers. Read the interest terms and any fees, and consider whether you could pay the balance off in full.
segments.tr: - Cẩn thận với các ưu đãi tài chính. Đọc các điều khoản lãi suất và bất kỳ khoản phí nào, và xem xét liệu bạn có thể thanh toán toàn bộ số dư hay không.

segments.src: - Avoid carrying a large holiday balance into the new year if you can.
segments.tr: - Tránh mang theo số dư kỳ nghỉ lớn sang năm mới nếu có thể.

segments.src: - Watch for scams around the busy shopping period, especially unexpected links, fake delivery notices and deals that seem too good to be true.
segments.tr: - Đề phòng các hành vi lừa đảo xung quanh thời điểm mua sắm bận rộn, đặc biệt là các liên kết bất ngờ, thông báo giao hàng giả và các ưu đãi có vẻ quá tốt để là sự thật.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Những gì cần theo dõi tiếp theo

segments.src: As the season goes on, several indicators will show whether the forecasts hold up: retail sales reports, consumer confidence surveys, delivery and shipping volumes, credit and delinquency data, and the results retailers report after the season ends.
segments.tr: Khi mùa giải diễn ra, một số chỉ số sẽ cho thấy liệu các dự báo có trụ vững hay không: báo cáo doanh số bán lẻ, khảo sát niềm tin người tiêu dùng, khối lượng giao hàng và vận chuyển, dữ liệu tín dụng và nợ quá hạn, và kết quả mà các nhà bán lẻ báo cáo sau khi mùa giải kết thúc.

segments.src: Early signals, such as the pace of sales in the weeks before the main shopping days, can be useful but are often revised.
segments.tr: Các tín hiệu sớm, chẳng hạn như tốc độ bán hàng trong những tuần trước những ngày mua sắm chính, có thể hữu ích nhưng thường được sửa đổi.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The most likely outcome is a season of selective spending.
segments.tr: Kết quả có nhiều khả năng xảy ra nhất là một mùa chi tiêu có chọn lọc.

segments.src: Many households will still shop, but they are expected to be more deliberate about what they buy, when they buy it and how they pay.
segments.tr: Nhiều hộ gia đình sẽ vẫn mua sắm, nhưng họ dự kiến sẽ có chủ ý hơn về những gì họ mua, khi nào họ mua và cách họ thanh toán.

segments.src: For retailers, the challenge is to attract careful shoppers without relying only on deep discounts.
segments.tr: Đối với các nhà bán lẻ, thách thức là thu hút những người mua sắm cẩn trọng mà không chỉ dựa vào giảm giá sâu.

segments.src: For families, the best approach is a realistic budget and a clear view of what they can afford once the holidays are over.
segments.tr: Đối với các gia đình, cách tiếp cận tốt nhất là một ngân sách thực tế và cái nhìn rõ ràng về những gì họ có thể mua được sau khi kỳ nghỉ kết thúc.
